newsitem.title: USA: Sigma Designs stock falls on weak results outlook.
newsitem.headline: Sigma Designs stock falls on weak results outlook.

text.p: The stock of Sigma Designs Inc. lost one-third of its value Friday, a day after the maker of multimedia computer devices and products said it expected to report a "small" profit on unexpectedly weak sales in the fourth quarter.
The stock fell $3 to $6 at mid-afternoon on Nasdaq, where it was the biggest percentage loser of the day.

Sigma said it expected to post sales of about $9.5 million in the fourth quarter ended Jan. 31. This is lower than previously expected due to a delay in the receipt of graphics chips from a semiconductor foundry in the Far East, compounded with surprisingly weak demand for its Explorer chipset, it said.
The Fremont, Calif.-based company had net income of $23 million on sales of $7.3 million in the year-ago fourth quarter.
